schema.sharedShape: 下面每个键都具有相同的形态：

glossary.$comment-surface: surface has no single Chinese equivalent, so it renders by sense and 表面 is no longer used for any of them: the machine-readable surface is 机器可读接口, and every sentence naming that referent uses 接口; derived surfaces, generated views and agent output alike, are 派生产物; a broader-audience or less-restricted surface is 内容载体; a read surface is 可读输入来源; and where surface names what an artifact does, the sentence says it instead (变更日志用于呈现近期变更, 记录以其日期标示时效, 用于声明新近程度的信息载体).
glossary.surface: 按义项翻译：机器可读接口 / 派生产物 / 内容载体 / 可读输入来源（不用「表面」）
glossary.$comment-nav-versioning: nav.specDocs.versioning stays 版本管理 against semver zh-CN's 版本控制, which reads as version control; the chapter is version policy. https://semver.org/lang/zh-CN/
glossary.$comment-changelog: Kept as 变更日志 against Keep a Changelog zh-CN's 更新日志: the artifact records changes including removals and deprecations, and pairs with 决策记录. https://keepachangelog.com/zh-CN/1.1.0/
glossary.authority (to approve or decide): 批准权 / 决定权（绝不用「权限」）
glossary.$comment-review: Kept as 评审 against GitHub Docs zh's 审查, which carries an inspection connotation; 评审 is the neutral assess-and-decide word for a gate a person owns. https://docs.github.com/zh/pull-requests/collaborating-with-pull-requests/proposing-changes-to-your-work-with-pull-requests/about-pull-requests
glossary.$comment-owner: Kept as 负责人 against GitHub Docs zh's 所有者, which is possession: Leji's owner is the person accountable for a document or a decision. https://docs.github.com/zh/get-started/learning-about-github/github-glossary
glossary.$comment-steward: Changed from 托管方 to 受托方, and stewardship from 托管 to 受托责任, so 托管 is free for its established hosting sense: GitHub Pages 是一种静态站点托管服务. https://docs.github.com/zh/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/about-github-pages
glossary.hosted service / hosted viewer: 托管服务 / 托管查看器
glossary.$comment-attest: 一致性声明 for a conformance claim and 自我声明 for self-attested are a deliberate pair, mirroring the English claim / attest; 自我声明 is the conformity-assessment term (GB/T 27050, ISO/IEC 17050), and 声称 would read as an unverified assertion.
glossary.$comment-rfc2119: Kept as 必须 / 不得 / 应当 / 不应 / 可以 / 推荐, the Chinese national-standard drafting register, against semver zh-CN's colloquial 应该 / 不应该; the row keeps the RFC 2119 marker so normative force traces to the English. https://semver.org/lang/zh-CN/
glossary.MUST / MUST NOT / SHOULD / SHOULD NOT /: 必须 / 不得 / 应当 / 不应 / 可以 / 推荐（RFC 2119；规范性效力以英文原文为准）
glossary.$comment-informative-translation: Kept as 资料性译文 against MDN zh-CN's 信息性: 资料性 is the Chinese national-standard counterpart to 规范性, which is exactly the pairing the spec banner makes. https://developer.mozilla.org/zh-CN/docs/Glossary/Normative
glossary.$comment-freshness: Kept as 时效性 against MDN zh-CN's 新鲜度, which is HTTP-cache jargon and reads oddly of a document. https://developer.mozilla.org/zh-CN/docs/Web/HTTP/Guides/Caching
glossary.$comment-federation: Unverified: no human-translated corpus page carrying the term was reachable (MDN zh-CN has no Fediverse entry). 联邦 is the standard rendering in 联邦学习 / 联邦宇宙 and nothing read contradicts it.
glossary.pin: 固定版本（指版本固定；选定智能体宿主用「指定」，侧栏固定位置用「固定」）
glossary.$comment-hydrate: Kept as 填充: React zh-hans renders hydration as 激活, but that is the server-rendered-HTML sense, not materializing a mount at its pin. https://zh-hans.react.dev/reference/react-dom/client/hydrateRoot
glossary.hydrate: 填充（在固定版本处物化；默认离线，只有 --fetch 才联网）
glossary.$comment-canonical: Kept as 权威的: MDN zh-CN renders rel=canonical as 首选 / 首要 URL, the search-engine sense; Leji's canonical is the text of record, which the spec pages already carry as 权威模式 / 权威内容. https://developer.mozilla.org/zh-CN/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Attributes/rel
glossary.selector specificity: 选择器特定性（MDN 中文译作“优先级”；此处特指选择器的具体程度）
glossary.$comment-checkout: Kept as 工作副本 against GitHub Docs zh's 签出 and 检出: Leji's checkout is the noun "the local working copy", which those verbs do not express. https://docs.github.com/zh/get-started/learning-about-github/github-glossary
glossary.$comment-escalation: Kept as 上报, the organizational sense "raise to a person who decides"; never k8s zh's 提级, which renders privilege escalation. https://kubernetes.io/zh-cn/docs/concepts/security/rbac-good-practices/
